title: Welsh Index of Multiple Deprivation 2019 index and domain scores
description: WIMD 2019 overall index score and the eight domain scores (income, employment, health, education, access to services, housing, community safety, physical environment) for every Welsh LSOA.

files.note: "WIMD 2019 Index and domain scores by small area", released 27 November 2019 and last updated 1 October 2020. Sheets: Guidance_Sheet, Data, WIMD_2019_LSOA_index_and_domain_scores.

CSV export of the WIMD_2019_LSOA_index_and_domain_scores sheet, read by the loader. Carries the sheet's three-line preamble, so the real header is on line 4 and data starts on line 5: 1,909 LSOAs x 12 columns. Should disappear once the preprocessor reads the .ods directly via the reader's odsContent.

"WIMD 2019 index and domain ranks by small area", as published at https://www.gov.wales/sites/default/files/statistics-and-research/2022-02/welsh-index-multiple-deprivation-2019-index-and-domain-ranks-by-small-area.ods. The loader reads the published overall rank and decile from the Deciles_quintiles_quartiles table. Ranks must not be recomputed from the scores sheet: its scores are rounded to one decimal place, and re-ranking them disagrees with the published rank for 1,341 of 1,909 LSOAs.

ONS mid-2017 small area population estimates, all ages, persons, for the 1,909 Welsh LSOAs (2011): the population year WIMD 2019 used for its own denominators. Retrieved from Nomis dataset NM_2010_1 (Population estimates - small area based by single year of age) on 17 September 2026 with https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/api/v01/dataset/NM_2010_1.data.csv?geography=TYPE298&date=2017&gender=0&c_age=200&measures=20100&select=date_name,geography_code,geography_name,obs_value (two pages, recordoffset=25000), keeping W01 codes and sorting by code. Totals 3,125,165, the published mid-2017 population of Wales. Open Government Licence v3.0. Used to weight LSOA scores into an average score for a group of areas, as MHCLG does for local authorities.
